title: Normalized provenance result, schema v1
description: One document produced identically by the browser analyzer, the c2pa-check CLI, the provenance engine and the c2pa.design API.

signer_name.description: Organization, else common name, of the certificate that signed the ingredient's manifest. Absent when the manifest is not in the store.

origin.description: Whether the chain of validated ingredients reaches a signer on the selected trust list. It never changes credential.status. Absent in documents produced before the field existed.

status.description: none: the file's own credential is not valid. traced: it is valid and it, or a manifest reached through validated parentOf or componentOf ingredients (depth 8, 512 manifests), is signed by a listed signer. untraced: valid, no listed signer reached.

signer_name.description: The nearest listed signer. Only when traced.

relationship.description: Relationship of the ingredient that points at the listed signer's manifest. Only when traced at depth 1 or more.

depth.description: Ingredient hops to the listed signer; 0 when the file's own signer is listed. Only when traced.

pdq.description: 256-bit PDQ perceptual hash of the decoded raster (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF; AVIF and HEIC where the engine decodes them), alpha-composited onto white, as 64 lowercase hex characters. For an animated image, the first kept frame. Absent when the image could not be decoded or is not a raster.

pdq_quality.description: PDQ quality metric. Below 50 the hash is unreliable for matching.

pdq_black.description: PDQ of the image alpha-composited onto black. Present only when a pixel is not fully opaque.

pdq_mirrors.description: PDQ of the horizontal and the vertical mirror, derived from the same DCT. Used to probe for mirrored copies.

pdq_frames.description: Animated images only: PDQ of up to 16 kept frames (about one per second of frame time, near-duplicates and frames below quality 50 dropped).

metadata.description: Embedded IPTC/Exif/XMP metadata presence, scored as IPTC Metawatch does. Present for every image media type.

four_cs_score.description: 25 each for Creator, Copyright, CaptionDescription and CreditLine.

digital_source_type.description: Last path segment of Iptc4xmpExt:DigitalSourceType from XMP.

watermarks.description: Invisible watermarks the engine decoded from the pixels (Adobe TrustMark on JPEG, PNG and WebP). Engine only: the browser analyzer and the CLI never set it. Absent when none was found. Never changes credential.status: anyone can embed any payload.

algorithm.description: Algorithm id on the C2PA soft-binding list, e.g. com.adobe.trustmark.C.

payload.description: Hex of the decoded bits, left-padded to whole nibbles.

encoding.description: bch_5: a 61-bit identifier. bch_super: a 40-bit signpost naming another soft-binding algorithm.

signpost.description: Added by the c2pa.design API: the soft-binding algorithm a bch_super payload names.

credentialStatus.description: The only field a user interface colors. Never REAL or FAKE.
